title: LogStreamEvent
description: One event delivered on an ingestion pipeline log Server-Sent Events stream. Every event carries the cursor a client needs to resume the stream where it left off.

logStreamEventType.description: Kind of event delivered on the stream.

logStreamEndReason.description: Why the server stopped streaming. Only set on a `complete` event. A stream that ends without one of these was cut short — reconnect from the last cursor.

runId.description: Run the streamed logs belong to. Absent when the pipeline has no recorded run to bind the stream to and the log backend is serving its latest logs instead.

logs.description: Log content appended since the previous event. Empty on `complete` and `error` events.

after.description: Opaque cursor pointing just past `logs`. Pass it back as the `after` query parameter to resume the stream without re-reading what was already delivered.

replay.description: True when this chunk was replayed from the server's buffer because the stream was already running when this client connected, rather than read fresh from log storage.

truncated.description: True when the server could not replay the whole backlog. The client must fetch the earlier history from the paginated log endpoint.

message.description: Human readable detail. Set on `error` events and on `complete` events that ended early.
